poc_results_summary: Trial duration: 5 weeks on Hosted API; integrated via SDK + proxy for feature flagging.
Observed baseline steady-state QPS: 12-18 (per primary app).
Observed daily peak QPS during business hours: 85-110. Weekend peaks 35-45.
95th percentile token-latency (hosted): 120-170 ms for 512-token prompt/response workloads. Tail spikes tied to cold KV cache misses.
Average tokens per request (observed): prompt 420 tokens, response 260 tokens -> average round-trip ~680 tokens.
Token mix: 60% short (<=256 tokens), 35% medium (257-1024), 5% long (>1024).
Reranking workload: batched jobs producing burst QPS up to 300 QPS for 10-15 minute windows during nightly refreshes.
Quality note: 4-bit quantization reduced latency by ~20% but increased hallucination rate in complex summarization prompts; retention of full-precision for long-form summarization recommended.
Integrations: KMS OK via Redwood private key wrapping; audit logs need 90-day retention export to their SIEM.
Suggested next: sizing worksheet + runbook for autoscaling thresholds and cache warmup to limit tail latency.
capacity_needs: Conservative forecast (finance): reserve for steady 25 QPS, burst to 120 QPS -> recommend 2-3 reserved GPUs (A10-class) with 2x burst nodes.
Expected/Preferred: steady 40 QPS with peaks 300 QPS during rerank windows -> recommend 4-6 GPUs (H100/A100 mix) with autoscale to add 2-4 transient GPUs for bursts.
Concurrency estimate: typical concurrency 25-60; peak concurrency measured ~150 during 1-hour incident test.
Token throughput forecast: average 700 tokens/request, expected monthly token volume 250M-750M depending on adoption curve.
Cache strategy: prefix/KV caching for chat to reduce repeated tokens; recommend conservative cache TTLs for premium customers.
Latency targets: 95th < 150ms for 512-token workflows; SLA ask for <200ms 95th across EU region required.

Recommendation: start with Hosted to unlock quick dev velocity, then transition to Dedicated with 12-month reserved capacity after month-2 of production traffic if usage aligns with 'Expected' forecast.
qps_forecast: Month 1 (post-trial): steady 18 QPS, peak 90 QPS; Month 3: steady 35 QPS, peak 200 QPS; Month 6: steady 60 QPS, peak 300 QPS.
expected_concurrency: Typical 30-60 concurrent requests; stress-tested peak 150 concurrent short bursts.
pricing_expectation: Customer expects 20-30% discount for 12mo committed spend and additional 10% for 24mo; wants explicit QPS tiers and burst pricing. Finance wants burn-rate model (tokens/QPS) to compare to in-house GPU costs.
discussion_highlights: Customer likes Redwood's routing/fallback policy ideas - wants automatic fallback to cheaper quantized models when non-critical but keep FP for long-form generation.
They requested an explicit canary plan for migration from Hosted to Dedicated with no UX regressions.
Emphasized need for observability: per-route token costs, per-customer latency heatmaps and per-model quality regression alerts.
